items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: Sometime like my father, he would come home 3 o'clock in the morning. He would get the blues, he would sit on the back step in the yard all night long with the guitar.

ctx.x: Yeah, the tune and something like that.

And the people never had heard it. And he put that mute in there and making that wah-wah. Well, they give him the cup. So that from then on, Celestan held the whole city. And it wasn't soon later that Sam went on because he took a stroke, you know. Yeah. But Sam had held the city for many years. Went all on the coast and everywhere with Sam Morgan. And they would meet up out there like on a Sunday. Or they would meet up on the corner and they would get in the bucket. And they would hook them tailgates together.…
Yeah, they wouldn't call the police.
